description: Create a new role with a chosen set of permissions — for when no existing role fits what the merchant wants someone to do. Check get_roles first; a near-match plus update_role is usually better than a fourth almost-identical role. PERMISSIONS ARE POWER. Confirm with the merchant first, naming the person and the role out loud ("give Maria the Manager role — yes?"), and never act on a role change you inferred rather than were asked for. The change is live on the next request: rights are re-read from the role every time, so no one logs out and no agent key stops working — including yours, if the change reaches your own account. Permission ids come from get_permissions. List back in plain words what the role will be able to do and get an explicit yes before calling. Creating a role gives nobody anything until assign_role puts a person on it. If you are signed in as an employee you can only grant permissions you hold yourself — the cabinet works the same way — and the call is refused otherwise.

name.description: What the merchant calls it, e.g. "Shift lead"

permissionIds.description: Permission ids from get_permissions — everything not listed is switched off
